combo_label: In the Bathroom × Maps & Navigation × Beatrix Potter

entries.clue: Slippery bar that leaps from wet hands like a fish
Its wooden fingers tell you how far to the next village
Near Sawrey house her royalties bought in 1905, kept just as she left it
Corner panel that decodes a map's tiny pictures
Tank behind the throne that sighs as it refills
Morning armpit armour, rolled or sprayed on
Rubber-cupped rescuer of hopelessly blocked drains
Three initials whose satellite signals let your phone work out where it stands
Military munitions lending their name to Britain's official mapping survey
Disobedient rabbit in blue who gorged on radishes and dodged a rake
Whiskered attic ruffian who rolled a kitten in dough for a roly-poly pudding
Impertinent red who pelted Old Brown with riddles and paid with his tail
Great speckled gulper that spat out a frog on tasting his coat
